name: @pipeworx/mcp-dwd-climate

tools.name: dwd_stations
tools.description: Find German Weather Service (DWD) climate stations by name or nearest to a coordinate. Returns station id, name, federal state, elevation, coordinates and the first/last date of daily climate observations, with distance when searching by lat/lon. Use the station_id with dwd_daily or dwd_latest. Covers ~1,400 current and closed stations across Germany. Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst.

name.description: Station or place name, substring match, umlauts optional (e.g. "Dresden", "Muenchen", "Zugspitze")

lat.description: Latitude for a nearest-station search (use with lon)

lon.description: Longitude for a nearest-station search (use with lat)

tools.name: dwd_daily
tools.description: Daily climate observations for one German DWD station over a date range: mean/max/min temperature, precipitation, sunshine hours, snow depth, wind speed and gusts, humidity, pressure and cloud cover, each with DWD quality flags. Ranges older than ~500 days come from the quality-controlled historical archive (back to the station's first record, some to the 1800s); recent days from the daily update. Max 1000 days per call. Get station_id from dwd_stations.

station_id.description: DWD station number (e.g. "1048" Dresden-Klotzsche, "433" Berlin-Tempelhof, "3379" München-Stadt)

tools.name: dwd_latest
tools.description: Most recent daily climate observation for one German DWD station (usually yesterday): temperature mean/max/min, precipitation, sunshine, snow depth, wind and humidity, with quality flags. Get station_id from dwd_stations.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dwd-climate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dwd-climate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
